policy.exposure: one-sided certified site-boundary spans attributed to the object's own part segments; hidden = segment length - exposed (listed per segment)
policy.assignment: the room's wall trades under a rule requiring PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (+ OWNER_PHYSICAL_AUTHORITY for a built obstacle) for the listed room classes; otherwise UNRESOLVED
policy.skirting: never created here (frozen contact path only)
never: a finish because an object is a column or duct
an obstacle finish without owner physical authority
an object face merged into WALL_FACE
a duct rule applied to a room class it does not cover

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification states the column finish

method.principle: an EXPOSED column face inside a room follows the surrounding room treatment
requires: PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (the face is a room-facing boundary of the certified room)
dry_area: SKIRTING (on the existing wall-contact path only)
wet_full_wall_tile_area: PORCELAIN / WALL TILE (the room's wall-tile trade and height)
method.height: the room's own authorised wall-finish height for that trade
method.physical_class: COLUMN_FACE stays its own class; it is never merged into WALL_FACE

never: a finish because an object is structurally a column
a finish on a hidden / embedded / wall-buried face
paint on a wet / full-wall-tile column
normal skirting in a full-wall-tile room
new skirting where the contact path already covers the face

identity: every SEGMENT part whose geometry role is STRUCTURAL_OBSTACLE (all segments of each column entity, exposed or not)
exposure: certified site-boundary spans of the class, attributed to the object's own segments
skirting: unchanged V4 path (COLUMN_FACE component); wet / full-tile rooms NO_SKIRTING
